== Root menu ==

Hello. Thanks for creating an account! Also, thanks for the compliment. I, and a lot of other contributors, try to keep things up. :) In regards to the Root menu, if you mean the Root category, then I have an answer for you. A little while ago, I restructured the top-level categories. We now have [[:Category:The Wheel of Time]] as the top level category. Underneath that are two categories, [[:Category:In-universe content|one for in-universe content]] and [[:Category:Real-world content|one for real-word content]]. Hope that is what you needed. Please let me know if you have any other questions! Thanks again. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 22:16, December 31, 2012 (UTC)



Thanks for the swift reply - I really appreciate it. It never occured to me to search for 'category'! This looks like a great way to organise the inital menu.
